summary: Retested the Enter-to-submit bugfix on /new. All 4 scenarios passed: (1) Enter in thesis textarea fires POST /api/ai/generate/stream and renders a strategy card with start-practice-btn in ~13s with no error banner; (2) 'Draft the rules' button still works and card appears ~6s; (3) Shift+Enter inserts newline and does NOT fire a request; (4) no 'weft' text appears anywhere on the page after drafting.
critical_code_review_comments: During button-click regression a transient 422 was logged in the console once (resource load error) but the stream recovered and the strategy card still rendered successfully — worth a passive check in server logs that /api/ai/generate/stream never rejects valid thesis payloads.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bugfix for Enter-key submit on /new thesis-input is verified working. Enter triggers draft(), Shift+Enter inserts newline. Strategy card renders in 6-13s on preview env. No 'weft' leakage. Draft button regression also passes.
rca of the issue: Original bug: textarea had no onKeyDown so Enter did nothing. Fix in New.jsx adds onKeyDown that calls draft() on Enter (without Shift). Verified via Playwright: request fired, card rendered.
